title: 3 第三章
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

从未感受过的战意顺着血管流向心脏，在静谧的夜色中，都竞华能听到自己胸腔内响亮的心跳声。

目前还剩下两个猎物。

她一面冷静地寻找剩下的目标，一面思考眼前的局势。

让都竞华有些意外的是，狩猎方的生命值似乎并不多，完全不能与之前的迷宫怪物相提并论。

虽然都竞华第一下攻击特地用了魔法箭矢，而且幸运地触发了暴击效果，但能被一箭直接清空血条……都竞华对敌人的详细情况有了一些猜测。

当下的临时事件，或许是卡着自己的实力上限来的。

充满危险，却又留下了一丝生路。

因为都竞华是个纯粹的萌新，所以来追杀她这个脆皮大学生的，综合实力也很一般。

都竞华微微定神，保持着拉弓的姿势。

刚刚的攻击算是打草惊蛇，都竞华更多是想确认袭击方的状态。

她的目光从周围的掩体上扫过，那些被提前拿来掩饰身形的物品表面遍布着许多箭孔，都是都竞华刚刚为了生成魔法箭矢而留下的。

都竞华目前只能存储两支魔法箭矢，不过她卡了个bug，在敌人抵达之前，连续射了六十次箭，第三支魔法箭矢因为无法存储，所以一直被她搭在弓弦上，直到刚才终于用它送走了一位袭击者。

“砰！”

袭击者也不会只是被动地等待都竞华的反应，这一刻，风中骤然响起了细微的枪声。

夜色下，一枚子弹向着水塔顶层飞来。

子弹的轨道有些低，最终击中了水塔下方的支架。

原本就因为年久失修而不慎稳固的水塔，在遭受子弹的冲击力后，愈发摇摇欲坠起来。

刚刚的攻击暴露了都竞华的位置，敌人已经知道了她的藏身地点。

“……好像有点不公平。”

都竞华无声自语了一句。

她用的长弓是冷兵器，可敌人用的却是热武器。

双方装备上的差距令自己本就不高的胜率再度雪上加霜。

不过作为一个乐观的人，都竞华立刻安慰自己，从游戏的角度考虑，枪械跟弓箭应该只存在数值上的区别，不至于真的无法硬刚。

烂尾楼附近各种废弃物都挺多，都竞华在水塔顶堆了许多掩体，除了为射击留下的空档外，将自己遮得严严实实。

然而严密的防护却拖累了她攻击的节奏。

就在都竞华积极寻找目标的时候，下方又是两枪快速飞来。

生锈水塔下方本就不够牢固的支架迅速断了一根。

都竞华：“……”

感受着建筑物的摇曳感，都竞华不断在心中告诉自己，作为支架，三角形就已经足够稳定。

不过袭击方显然并不满足于只打掉水塔的一根支架，很快，第四枚子弹已然射出——

几乎就在同时，一道新的箭矢从水塔顶层飞出，上面并未附加着魔法的力量，不过角度很准确，将[弓术入门]的威力发挥到了极限，直接在半空拦住了子弹。

射击的轨迹发生了偏移。

都竞华意识到了对方真正的目的——想要摧毁水塔只是一方面，对方更希望试探自己的能力，同时消耗她的箭矢储备。

第一个游戏奖励的箭矢确实很少，意外来得又特别紧急，都竞华压根没时间去收购补充。

而袭击方是有备而来，弹药储备绝对比都竞华多。

Page (1/3)

The fighting spirit that he had never felt before flowed along the blood vessels to the heart. In the quiet night, Du Jinghua could hear the loud heartbeat in his chest.

There are currently two prey left.

She calmly searched for the remaining targets while thinking about the situation in front of her.

What surprised Du Jinghua was that the hunting party didn't seem to have much health, and it couldn't be compared with the previous maze monsters at all.

Although Du Jinghua specially used magic arrows for his first attack, and was lucky enough to trigger a critical hit, but the health bar could be cleared directly by one arrow... Du Jinghua had some guesses about the details of the enemy.

The current temporary incident may be caused by the upper limit of his own strength.

Full of danger, but leaving a way of survival.

Because Du Jinghua is a pure newbie, the one who comes to hunt down her, a crispy college student, has average overall strength.

Du Jinghua calmed down slightly and maintained the posture of drawing the bow.

The attack just now was considered as a warning, but Du Jinghua wanted to confirm the status of the attacker.

Her eyes swept over the surrounding bunkers. The objects that had been used to conceal her figure were dotted with many arrow holes, which Du Jinghua had left just now to generate magic arrows.

Du Jinghua could only store two magic arrows at present, but she had a bug and shot sixty times in a row before the enemy arrived. The third magic arrow could not be stored, so she kept it on the bowstring until she finally used it to send away an attacker.

"Bang!"

The attacker would not just wait passively for Du Jinghua's reaction. At this moment, a subtle gunshot suddenly sounded in the wind.

Under the night, a bullet flew toward the top of the water tower.

The bullet's trajectory was somewhat low and eventually struck the support below the water tower.

The water tower, which was originally unstable due to disrepair, became increasingly shaky after suffering the impact of bullets.

The attack just now exposed Du Jinghua's location, and the enemy already knew her hiding place.

"...It seems a bit unfair."

Du Jinghua muttered to himself silently.

The longbow she used was a cold weapon, but the enemy used a hot weapon.

The disparity in equipment between the two sides made their already low winning rate even worse.

However, as an optimistic person, Du Jinghua immediately comforted himself. From the perspective of the game, there should only be a numerical difference between firearms and bows, and they would not really be incapable of fighting.

There were a lot of various kinds of waste near the unfinished building. Du Jinghua piled many bunkers on top of the water tower, covering himself tightly except for the gaps left for shooting.

However, the tight protection slowed down the pace of her attack.

Just when Du Jinghua was actively looking for the target, two more shots flew quickly from below.

One of the already weak supports underneath the rusty water tower quickly broke.

Du Jinghua: "..."

Feeling the swaying feeling of the building, Du Jinghua kept telling himself that as a support, the triangle was stable enough.

However, the attacker was obviously not satisfied with just knocking off one bracket of the water tower. Soon, the fourth bullet was fired——

Almost at the same time, a new arrow flew out from the top of the water tower. There was no magic power attached to it, but the angle was very accurate. It maximized the power of [Introduction to Archery] and stopped the bullet in mid-air.

The trajectory of the shot was deflected.

Du Jinghua realized the other party's true purpose - wanting to destroy the water tower was only one aspect. The other party wanted to test his own abilities and consume her arrow reserves at the same time.

The arrows rewarded in the first game were indeed very few, and the surprise came so urgently that Du Jinghua had no time to purchase and replenish them.

The attackers were well prepared and had more ammunition than Du Jinghua.
